CREATE Procedure CDN.KOL_SprawdzMagZasob(@Ope_Numer int,@Mag_GidNumer int,@Mag_AdresID int) AS BEGIN
SELECT Twr_Kod as KOD, Twr_Nazwa as Nazwa, Tzm_Ilosc as [Ilość], isnull(CDN.PobierzMagAdres(Mga_Id),'<N/O>') as [Położenie], Mag_Kod as [Magazyn], (case when tpa_ccknumer=twr_ccknumer then TpA_Cecha else '' end) as [Cecha], Twr_jm as [Jm], (case when TpA_DataW=0 then '-' else convert(nvarchar(25),dateadd(d,TpA_DataW,'18001228'),104) end) as [DataW] FROM CDN.TwrZasobyMag LEFT JOIN CDN.MagAdresy ON TZM_MgAId = Mga_Id JOIN CDN.Magazyny on TZM_MagNumer = Mag_GidNumer JOIN CDN.TwrPartie ON TpA_Id=TZM_TPaId JOIN CDN.TwrKarty ON Tpa_TwrNumer = Twr_GidNumer AND Tpa_TwrTyp = Twr_GidTyp WHERE (isnull(Mga_Id,0) = @Mag_AdresID OR -1=@Mag_AdresID) AND Mag_GidNumer = @Mag_GidNumer
END
